		Introduction
	

CII-Bench comprises 698 Chinese images, each accompanied by 1 to 3 multiple-choice questions, totaling 800 questions. CII-Bench encompasses images from six distinct domains: Life, Art, Society, Environment, Politics, and Chinese Traditional Culture. It also features a diverse array of image types, including Illustrations, Memes, Posters, Multi-panel Comics, Single-panel Comics, and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/m-a-p/CII-Bench.
typical_sota_score: varies by model; reported/model-dependent ranges often ~70–95%
reputation: Relatively small, recent dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for Chinese multimodal VQA research.
